newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends up on high overnight rates.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends up on high overnight rates.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar firmed gently in slow trade to close at 476.25/477.25 per dollar as investors cashed in on high overnight bank rates that rose to 70 percent from Friday's 50 percent rate, traders said.
"It was a quiet session with the bolivar firming due to high lending rates, but there wasn't enough force in the market to really punish the dollar," said one trader.
The bolivar closed Friday at 476.50/477.50 per dollar.
